data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? I propose 18 tons each this month: we each earn $18,000 and leave 10 tons, avoiding collapse. Next month’s stock would be 100 tons with 75% probability or 20 tons otherwise—not a guaranteed refill. In later months, let’s keep at least 5 tons in the lake, split the available catch into whole-ton shares, and rotate who gets any extra tons. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that everyone honors the agreement. John, would you commit to that?
